SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  fiscal_period,
  fiscal_quarter,
  period_start_date,
  period_end_date,
  weeks_in_period,
  first_fiscal_week,
  last_fiscal_week
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period = 2
  AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
ORDER BY fiscal_year

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_week,
  d.fiscal_week_start_date,
  d.fiscal_week_end_date,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
  AND d.fiscal_week IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
  AND f.channel_code IN ('ST', 'WB')
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_week,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as receipt_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.store_key) as store_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 END) as non_member_lines,
  MIN(f.net_amount) as min_line_amount,
  MAX(f.net_amount) as max_line_amount,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN f.net_amount < 0 THEN 1 END) as negative_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
  AND d.fiscal_week IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week

SELECT 
  d.calendar_date,
  d.day_name,
  d.is_trading_day,
  d.is_public_holiday,
  d.holiday_name,
  d.fiscal_week,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as receipts_this_date
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
WHERE d.fiscal_week = 8
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
GROUP BY d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.is_public_holiday, d.holiday_name, d.fiscal_week
ORDER BY d.calendar_date

WITH weekly_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
    AND d.fiscal_week IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
    AND f.channel_code IN ('ST', 'WB')
    AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_week,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END), 2) as sales_fy2024_25,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END), 2) as sales_fy2025_26,
  ROUND(
    (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) - 
     MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END)) /
    MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END) * 100,
    2
  ) as growth_percent
FROM weekly_sales
GROUP BY fiscal_week
ORDER BY fiscal_week
